items.description: An AI-powered educational platform for students with dysgraphia and dyscalculia, with personalized workflows adapted to Nepali educational contexts.

items.title: Shades of History
items.description: Generative image restoration and deep colorization for degraded Nepalese heritage photographs, with a live Hugging Face demo.

items.title: Abstractive QA
items.description: A Nepali question-answering system fine-tuned on MuRIL-large, with a full span-extraction pipeline and custom SQuAD evaluation logic.

items.title: ChandaParser
items.description: A Devanagari-aware prosody engine for identifying classical poetic meters through custom syllabification, Chandahashastra rules, and fuzzy matching.
Architecting data visualization automation for business decision flows and an autonomous stock replacement and replenishment agent with human-in-the-loop control.
Built production RAG and multi-agent market research systems across Healthcare, CPG, Supply Chain, and Construction, reducing manual research effort by 80% and processing time by 30%.
Designed a CV analysis and scoring engine using NLP and ML classification that automated 30% of recruitment screening, alongside production-readiness experiments.
Led applied AI research across generative AI, computer vision, heritage conservation, and human-wildlife conflict resolution; co-authored research published in 2025.
Built a RAG question-answering system for the Constitution of Nepal and contributed to the Merojob platform revamp across frontend and backend work.
